issues.text: New in round 2 (claim 15). The review doc separates the two limits: catalog-reads is shared per process, so a busy shop uses it up and other shops get 503 (R1, line 59); orders counts per customer, so nothing stops a busy shop with many customers (R2, line 60). 'use them up for every shop' is true only of the first. The next lesson's outline keeps these two findings distinct, so the sentence also blurs what it will teach.
